mapper.select: select PROD_ID prodid, PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode, AREA_CODE areaCode, HOLDER_TYPE holderType, sum(DAY_SALE_AMOUNT_SUM) saleAmountTotal, sum(DAY_VALUE_AMOUNT_SUM) valueAmountTotal, CCY ccy FROM CHB_SALE_DEAL_SUM WHERE EQUITY_CONF_DATE between to_date(#{batchDateStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') and to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') GROUP BY PRD_REGIST_CODE,INSTITUTION_CODE,AREA_CODE,HOLDER_TYPE,CCY,PROD_ID

select prdRegistCode, institutionCode, areaCode, holderType, ccy, sum(amount) saleAmountTotal, sum(qty) valueAmountTotal, sum(cnyAmt) cnyAmt FROM (select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, NVL(B.THE_BANK_CODE,B.REGIST_BANK_CODE) institutionCode, B.FUND_ACC_PLACE areaCode, CASE B.HOLDER_CLASSIFY when '01' THEN decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'01','01','02','01','03','01') when '02' THEN decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'01','02','02','02','03','02') ELSE decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'04','03','05','04','06','05','07','06','08','07','09','08','10','09','11','99','12','99','13','99','14','99','15','99','16','99','17','10', '18','10','19','10','20','10','21','10','22','10','23','10','24','99','25','99','99') END as holderType, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, A.CCY ccy, A.AMOUNT amount, A.QTY qty, A.CNY_AMT cnyAmt FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') )GROUP BY prdRegistCode,institutionCode,areaCode,holderType,ccy

select indentifyMark, prdRegistCode, institutionCode, areaCode, holderType, ccy, sum(amount) saleAmountTotal, sum(qty) valueAmountTotal, sum(cnyAmt) cnyAmt FROM (select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, NVL(B.THE_BANK_CODE,B.REGIST_BANK_CODE) institutionCode, B.FUND_ACC_PLACE areaCode, CASE B.HOLDER_CLASSIFY when '01' THEN decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'01','01','02','01','03','01') when '02' THEN decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'01','02','02','02','03','02') ELSE decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'04','03','05','04','06','05','07','06','08','07','09','08','10','09','11','99','12','99','13','99','14','99','15','99','16','99','17','10', '18','10','19','10','20','10','21','10','22','10','23','10','24','99','25','99','99') END as holderType, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, A.CCY ccy, A.AMOUNT amount, A.QTY qty, A.CNY_AMT cnyAmt FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') )GROUP BY prdRegistCode,institutionCode,areaCode,holderType,ccy,indentifyMark

select prdRegistCode, institutionCode, areaCode, holderType, ccy, sum(amount) saleAmountTotal, sum(qty) valueAmountTotal, sum(cnyAmt) cnyAmt FROM (select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, NVL(B.THE_BANK_CODE,B.REGIST_BANK_CODE) institutionCode, B.FUND_ACC_PLACE areaCode, CASE B.HOLDER_CLASSIFY when '01' THEN decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'01','01','02','01','03','01') when '02' THEN decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'01','02','02','02','03','02') ELSE decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'04','03','05','04','06','05','07','06','08','07','09','08','10','09','11','99','12','99','13','99','14','99','15','99','16','99','17','10', '18','10','19','10','20','10','21','10','22','10','23','10','24','99','25','99','99') END as holderType, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, A.CCY ccy, A.AMOUNT amount, A.QTY qty, A.CNY_AMT cnyAmt FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) temp1
temp1.indentifyMark NOT IN
#{regist.indentifyMark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY prdRegistCode,institutionCode,areaCode,holderType,ccy

select prdRegistCode, institutionCode, areaCode, holderType, ccy, sum(amount) saleAmountTotal, sum(qty) valueAmountTotal, sum(cnyAmt) cnyAmt FROM (select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, NVL(B.THE_BANK_CODE,B.REGIST_BANK_CODE) institutionCode, B.FUND_ACC_PLACE areaCode, CASE B.HOLDER_CLASSIFY when '01' THEN decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'01','01','02','01','03','01') when '02' THEN decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'01','02','02','02','03','02') ELSE decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'04','03','05','04','06','05','07','06','08','07','09','08','10','09','11','99','12','99','13','99','14','99','15','99','16','99','17','10', '18','10','19','10','20','10','21','10','22','10','23','10','24','99','25','99','99') END as holderType, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, A.CCY ccy, A.AMOUNT amount, A.QTY qty, A.CNY_AMT cnyAmt FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') )GROUP BY prdRegistCode,institutionCode,areaCode,holderType,ccy
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CHB_SALE_MONTH_REPORT_DETAIL WHERE REPORTUUID = (select REPORTUUID FROM CHB_SALE_MONTH_REPORT WHERE TERMID = to_date(#{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm'))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) from CHB_SALE_DEAL_SUM WHERE EQUITY_CONF_DATE between to_date(#{batchDateStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') and to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd')
SELECT COUNT(*) from CHB_SALE_DEAL_SUM WHERE EQUITY_CONF_DATE = to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd')
SELECT COUNT(*) from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB A left join CHB_EQU_SUB B ON A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd')

SELECT COUNT(*) from CHB_SALE_MONTH_REPORT A LEFT JOIN (SELECT detail.REPORTUUID reportuuid FROM CHB_SALE_MONTH_REPORT_DETAIL detail left join CHB_SALE_DEAL_SUM su ON detail.PRD_REGIST_CODE = su.PRD_REGIST_CODE and detail.INSTITUTION_CODE = su.INSTITUTION_CODE WHERE su.EQUITY_CONF_DATE BETWEEN to_date(#{batchDateStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') and to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) B ON A.REPORTUUID = B.reportuuid WHERE A.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03')
select EXCHANGE_PRICE from CHB_MST_EXCHANGE_INFO WHERE CCY_ORIGINAL =#{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and CCY_CONVERT = 'CNY'
select EXCHANGE_PRICE from CHB_MST_EXCHANGE_INFO WHERE CCY_ORIGINAL =#{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and CCY_CONVERT = 'USD'
select EXCHANGE_PRICE from CHB_MST_EXCHANGE_INFO WHERE CCY_ORIGINAL ='USD' and CCY_CONVERT = 'CNY'

SELECT PRODID prodid, DIRTYAMTSUM dirtyamtsum, CLEANAMTSUM cleanamtsum, ENDAMTSUM_OTH endamtsumOth FROM CHB_MONTH_PRD_POSITION WHERE STARTDATE = to_date(#{batchDateStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') and ENDDATE = to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd')

select prdRegistCode, holderType, count(indentifyMark) holderNum FROM (select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, CASE B.HOLDER_CLASSIFY when '01' THEN decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'01','01','02','01','03','01') when '02' THEN decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'01','02','02','02','03','02') ELSE decode(B.HOLDER_TYPE,'04','03','05','04','06','05','07','06','08','07','09','08','10','09','11','99','12','99','13','99','14','99','15','99','16','99','17','10', '18','10','19','10','20','10','21','10','22','10','23','10','24','99','25','99','99') END as holderType, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') )GROUP BY prdRegistCode,holderType

select prdRegistCode, fundAccPlace, count(DISTINCT(indentifyMark)) holderNum FROM (select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, B.FUND_ACC_PLACE fundAccPlace, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd')
UNION ALL
select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, B.FUND_ACC_PLACE fundAccPlace, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') )GROUP BY prdRegistCode,fundAccPlace

select prdRegistCode, institutionCode, count(DISTINCT(indentifyMark)) holderNum FROM (select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, B.THE_BANK_CODE institutionCode, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd')
UNION ALL
select A.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, B.THE_BANK_CODE institutionCode, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE A.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') )GROUP BY prdRegistCode,institutionCode
